steps.sql: SELECT REPLICATE('ab',3) AS a,REPLICATE(N'雪',3) AS n,REPLICATE(CAST('x' AS CHAR(3)),2) AS c,REPLICATE(CAST(N'x' AS NCHAR(3)),2) AS nc
SELECT REPLICATE('x',0) AS z,REPLICATE('x',-1) AS neg,REPLICATE('',-1) AS empty_neg,REPLICATE(NULL,3) AS absent,REPLICATE('x',NULL) AS missing_count
SELECT REPLICATE(CAST('x' AS VARCHAR(MAX)),3) AS a,REPLICATE(CAST(N'雪' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),3) AS n

SELECT DATALENGTH(REPLICATE('x',8100)) AS a,DATALENGTH(REPLICATE(N'x',4100)) AS n,DATALENGTH(REPLICATE(CAST('x' AS VARCHAR(MAX)),8100)) AS am,DATALENGTH(REPLICATE(CAST(N'x' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),4100)) AS nm
SELECT REPLICATE(12,3) AS number,REPLICATE(0x4142,3) AS bytes,REPLICATE('x',2.9) AS fraction
DECLARE @n INT=3; SELECT REPLICATE('ab',@n) AS a,REPLICATE(N'ab',@n) AS n
SELECT DATALENGTH(REPLICATE('x',CAST(2147483648 AS BIGINT))) AS large_count
SELECT REPLICATE('x','3') AS text_count,REPLICATE('x',CAST(2.9 AS FLOAT)) AS float_count
SELECT REPLICATE(CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),3) AS n
